items.headline: After a poor 2025 at home, the Ravens try to turn the page when they host New Orleans
items.description: Jesse Minter wasn't even with the Ravens last season, but the new coach seems to have a healthy grasp of how 2025 went so badly wrong for Baltimore.

items.headline: Saints' Alvin Kamara practices, 'moving well' after MCL sprain
items.description: Saints running back Alvin Kamara has "no limitations," was a full participant in practice and says his knee feels good only one month after spraining his MCL in practice.

items.headline: NFL Week 2 uniforms: Rams debut 'Classic Sol,' Ravens go all-white
items.description: Here's a look at what each NFL team is wearing in Week 2, led by a new alternate look from the Los Angeles Rams.

items.headline: The latest on Alvin Kamara and Cam Jordan
items.description: Katherine Terrell discusses the injury statuses of running back Alvin Kamara and defensive lineman Cam Jordan.

items.headline: Source: Saints' Zach Wood to miss time with Grade 2 calf strain
items.description: Saints long-snapper Zach Wood has a Grade II calf strain that could sideline him about 4-6 weeks, a source told ESPN.

items.headline: Saints' Alvin Kamara practices in full, 'in a great place'
items.description: Saints coach Kellen Moore said he "feels good" about Alvin Kamara's chance of playing Sunday. The veteran RB was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
